question: For the Broken Handheld with Weird Symbols, which music symbol pulses on the dead screen? (Canon only says "unfamiliar musical symbols")
options: A (recommended): a medieval neume — one chunky square lozenge with a hooked tail, one fainter behind it. Unfamiliar even to people who read music, and it points at Sinfonia's old-music pretension.
B: an invented glyph — three filled note-heads stacked on one diagonal beam, belonging to no notation system. Unfamiliar to everyone, impossible to mistake for a brand.
C: keep the treble clef the Asset ref used. Reads instantly, but contradicts the item's own word 'unfamiliar' and is the most familiar music symbol there is.
context: The treble clef shipped in the failed ref. The item's whole future use is an unreadable music clue for Sinfonia, so the glyph carries the joke. I can write it either way; A or B is a one-line swap in my description.
